summary: Tested the new DELETE /api/users/{id} feature (backend) and Settings > Users delete UI (frontend). 6/6 pytest tests pass; frontend smoke flow (create qa_del_* producer -> cancel keeps row -> confirm removes row + toast) passes. Pre-existing users were NOT touched -- only self-created qa_del_* users were deleted. Admin's own trash button is correctly disabled.
verified_flows: DELETE self (admin deleting own id) -> 400 'You cannot delete your own account'
DELETE producer -> 200 {ok: true}; victim's existing session cookie -> 401 on /api/auth/me; victim re-login -> 401; user absent from GET /api/users
Last-admin guard: deleting a qa_del admin while seeded admin remains succeeds (seeded admin never touched)
UI: Settings > Users renders rows with data-testid user-row-{username}; admin's own user-delete-admin button is disabled
UI: Add team member -> fills username/name/password -> submit creates row
UI: Trash on qa_del_ row opens delete-user-dialog with title 'Delete {name} (@{username})?'
UI: Cancel keeps the row; Confirm removes the row and shows sonner toast 'Deleted @qa_del_{suffix}'
critical_code_review_comments: backend/auth.py delete_user looks solid: self-guard, 404, last-admin guard (role==admin AND active, excludes target), and purges login_attempts by username suffix. One minor nit: the regex purge uses :{username}$ -- this works since identifier is '{ip}:{username}'. Fine.

Deleting a user does NOT reassign/clean up data owned by them (episodes/documents/plan_items). The dialog copy explicitly says 'Episodes they created stay in the library' so this is intentional, but worth remembering: author_id (if stored) will point at a missing user. Not a blocker.
Access tokens issued before deletion remain valid as JWTs until expiry (30 min), but get_current_user re-fetches the user from DB and 401s if missing -- verified. Good.

Frontend: own admin's role select + active switch are disabled, trash button disabled, but Reset button is NOT disabled -- admin can reset their own password via the Reset flow. That's by design (change-password exists too), not a bug.
The confirmation AlertDialog uses an irreversible red 'Delete user' primary; copy is clear. Good UX.
seed_data_creation: Tests create qa_del_* producers/admins and delete them within the same test (plus a cleanup fixture). The UI smoke created and deleted qa_del_993120. No pre-existing user was modified or deleted. conftest also snapshots+restores PRESERVE collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_delete_user.py (uses fixture 'created_users' that returns a factory producing qa_del_* users and auto-cleans). Frontend delete flow data-testids: user-row-{username}, user-delete-{username}, delete-user-dialog, delete-user-cancel-btn, delete-user-confirm-btn. Admin's own row has user-delete-admin disabled.
